description: JavaScript plugin for FullCalendar v2.2.7 integrating Google Calendar API, handling calendar source normalization, fetching events, and processing event data including custom categories.

methods.name: transformOptions
methods.description: Transforms source options to fetch Google Calendar events, handling API request setup, error reporting, and event data processing.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports errors encountered during API requests, calling error handlers and logging to console.

methods.name: injectQsComponent
methods.description: Injects query string parameters into URLs for event links.
